metadata.description: ALPS (PRD) authoring + ADR-driven development for Claude Code, as two independent plugins.

plugins.name: alps-writer
plugins.description: Author ALPS (PRD) documents via an MCP server — guided, section-by-section product specs. Hand Section 7 features to the adr-writer plugin with /feature-to-adr.

plugins.name: adr-writer
plugins.description: ADR-driven development cycle: author ADRs with /adr-new, implement with /adr-impl, apply verified low-risk refactors before completion, and sync with /adr-sync, with an ADR-first hook that re-injects the ADR map every turn. Works standalone, no ALPS PRD required.
